Core history later removed IG Publisher assets with commit 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b, stating that the publisher had gone to Maven. Current core and FHIR Extension Pack searches found no FHIR-17165, date-accuracy-indicator, accuracyIndicator slice, or Patient.deceasedDateTime.extension source requiring a spec edit.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the applied issue was a resolved IG Publisher behavior problem, not a current in-build FHIR core specification content defect.
